rss: Typical energy bill forecast to go up by £443 a year from January as inflation rate rises again
title: Energy Prices Are Going Up!
story: Energy prices are getting higher, which might make it cost more to turn on lights or play games. People might have to think about using less energy at home.
storyBig: A rise in energy prices can affect households significantly, leading to increased costs for electricity and heating. This can cause people to change how they use energy to manage their expenses.
think: How can we save energy at home?
bull: Learning to save energy helps the planet!
bear: Higher prices mean we might spend less on treats.

rss: The seven Anthropic founders who are about to become multi-billionaires
title: New Game Company Makes Big Money
story: A new video game company is making a lot of money! The people who started the company are becoming really rich because lots of kids want to play their games.
storyBig: The founders of a successful new video game company are seeing their wealth grow dramatically as more consumers purchase their games. This highlights the potential for significant financial gains in the gaming industry.
think: What makes a video game fun to play?
bull: Successful games can make fun new features!
bear: Not all games will be as popular.
